summary: P0 Bug Fix Testing - All 3 P0 fixes verified working. Full booking flow: HomePage → Results → PassengerDetails tested end-to-end. Date/time/passengers pre-fill correctly, flight fields always visible, sessionStorage persistence on refresh works, Navigate guard redirects correctly, capacity warnings work on PassengerDetails.

integration_issues.issue: When pickup display name includes '(LHR) – London, United Kingdom' format (full autocomplete display), the iWay places/find API resolves it to types=['geocode','premise'] instead of ['airport','establishment','point_of_interest']. However, fromIsAirport fallback correctly uses searchData.pickup_location.includes('airport') which contains 'Airport' in the string, so flightRequired=true works correctly.
integration_issues.priority: LOW - working via fallback, not a breaking issue

issues: Hero image contains embedded text 'HEADLINE TEXT OURAD' overlaid on the background, which appears on top of the hero content. This looks like placeholder template text inside the uploaded image itself, not a code issue but worth reviewing.

INFO: fromPlace.types from iWay API may return ['geocode','premise'] for full-format airport queries (e.g. 'London Heathrow Airport (LHR) – London, United Kingdom'). The fallback via searchData.pickup_location.includes('airport') works correctly. No action required.
critical_code_review_comments: showFlightFields=true hardcoded is correct fix - removes dependency on unreliable iWay types
fromIsAirport triple-check (types + address + pickup_location) is robust - good defensive coding
sessionStorage fallback in PassengerDetailsPage state restoration works correctly
Navigate component used instead of imperative navigate() in render - correct React pattern
iWay search passes full autocomplete display name as pickup/dropoff - could potentially cause type resolution issues with iWay API but fallbacks handle it
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 P0 bugs are fixed and verified: (1) showFlightFields=true - flight/terminal/greeting fields always visible, (2) sessionStorage backup + restore on PassengerDetailsPage survives refresh, (3) Navigate guard uses <Navigate replace> not navigate() in render. Full booking flow LHR → London Paddington with 2 pax, date+3 days, time 14:00 works end-to-end. The iWay API is live and returns 6 vehicles for this route in ~5-10 seconds. Capacity warnings work on PassengerDetails page. Direct URL guard redirects correctly.

rca_of_issues.p0_bug_1_flight_fields_hidden: Root cause: iWay API types field for pickup place sometimes returns ['geocode','premise'] instead of ['airport',...] causing isAirportType() to return false and showFlightFields=false. Fix: showFlightFields=true always + fromIsAirport checks address string as fallback. Verified working.
rca_of_issues.p0_bug_2_state_lost_on_refresh: Root cause: React router state not persisted across page reload. Fix: sessionStorage.setItem('pt_booking_state') in handleBook() + restore in PassengerDetailsPage state initialization. Verified: refresh stays on /passenger-details with all data restored.
rca_of_issues.p0_bug_3_guard_during_render: Root cause: calling navigate() inside render function causes React hooks violation. Fix: use <Navigate to='/' replace /> component in JSX return. Verified: direct URL access redirects correctly.
